custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have three active parts: part A and part C in category A, and part B in category B, so the category A filter leaves part B out.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425597 PART A ALPHA in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425597-A in Part Number, pick category A under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, then click Save. Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425597 PART B BRAVO in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425597-B in Part Number, pick category B under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, then click Save. Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425597 PART C CHARLIE in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425597-C in Part Number, pick category A under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, then click Save. (Pick the same category for A and C and another one for B.)
  • Give parts A, B and C part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists them, and descriptions that run A to Z in the order part A, part B, part C.
  • Make sure the test location has more than 30 active parts, so the list loads more rows as you scroll.
    • How to do it: The Active tab of Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 already lists more than 30 parts; scroll down to check that more rows load.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
